components.name: Button
components.designer_instructions: Purpose: primary interactive element. Variants: Solid/Outline/Ghost/Solid-Input. Sizes sm/md/lg/xl. States Default/Hover/Active/Focus/Disabled. Token refs use --color-primary-500/600/700, --radius-pill, --radius-button, --font-weight-semibold, --space-2, --color-focus-ring. AGENT INSTRUCTIONS: never hardcode color/spacing/size; Ghost wraps icon in circular pill; Disabled via --color-disabled-bg not CSS opacity; props: variant, size, disabled, leadingIcon, trailingIcon, label, onClick

components.name: Input
components.designer_instructions: Purpose: text input for user data entry. Types: TextInput/TextArea/TextInputGroup. Sizes: md (40px height) / lg (48px height). States: Default/Hover/Focused/Filled/Error/Success/Disabled. Token refs: --btn-height-md/lg, --radius-button (4px), --font-size-base, --color-error, --color-success, --color-disabled-bg. AGENT INSTRUCTIONS: never hardcode height; all border/text color changes via tokens; props: type, size, state, leadingIcon, showClearButton, showPasswordToggle, placeholder, value

components.name: Toggle
components.designer_instructions: Toggle component with LabelRow (optional). State axes: Active/Inactive/Disabled. ToggleSwitch sub-component: Inactive states (Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled) and Active states (Default/Hover/Focus). Active color: #2F9E44. Inactive color: #ACACAC. Disabled bg: #EAEAEA. FocusRing: box-shadow 4px amber + 2px white. Switch size: 48x24px. Knob: 20px circle. Token refs: colors/control/background/active, colors/control/background/disabled, FocusRing effect.

components.name: Checkbox
components.designer_instructions: State axes: Default/Hover/Focus/Active/Disabled × Selection: Unchecked/Checked/Indetermined. Plus Error state. Size: 24×24px (var --dimension/size/control/xs). Border-radius: 4px (var --component/radius/checkbox). Stroke: 2px (var --dimension/stroke-weight/md). Hover bg: #E7F5FF. Active fill: #1971C2. Error ring: box-shadow 4px #FFC9C9. FocusRing: 4px amber + 2px white. Disabled border: #D5D5D5. Disabled bg: #EAEAEA.

components.name: Dropdown
components.designer_instructions: Dropdown with TriggerRow + OptionList sub-components. Props: Show LabelRow (bool), Show HelperRow (bool). TriggerRow states: Default/Hover/Focus/Active/Disabled. Height: 48px. Border-radius: 4px. Trigger border default: #979797; hover/focus: #1971C2; active: #1864AB; disabled: #D5D5D5. Option hover bg: #E7F5FF. Active option bg: #1971C2. OptionItem types: MultiSelect / SingleSelect. FocusRing applied on Focus state. Page name note: 'Drodown' (typo for 'Dropdown'). Token refs: --color-control-border-default, --color-control-background-hover, --color-control-border-hover, --component-radius-input, --effect-focus-ring.

components.name: FormField
components.designer_instructions: Purpose: composite form field composing LabelRow + Input + HelperRow. Types: Input / InputArea / InputGroup. Spacing LabelRow→Input: var(--space-2) 8px; Input→HelperRow: var(--space-1) 4px. AGENT INSTRUCTIONS: always compose existing LabelRow, Input, HelperRow components; never re-implement their markup; helperState prop controls HelperRow state; props: type, size, label, required, showInfoIcon, helperState, helperMessage, and all Input props.
